name: 03 Lot Detail View — Details presentation and thumbnail switching

planSteps.description: Navigate to /index.html?page=explore and wait for the auction grid to render
Click the lot card link for 'The Heritage Chronograph'
Verify the breadcrumb shows LOT 024 and heading displays The Heritage Chronograph
Verify the estimate displays '₹2,00,000 – ₹3,00,000' and current highest bid is '₹2,40,000'
Verify the gallery instruction text displays 'SELECT AN IMAGE TO VIEW'
Click the button with aria-label 'View image 2'
Verify the lot story heading displays 'About this Timepieces'
